topics.name: Schumer Jeffries Leadership

perspectives.title: Remove Schumer

representative_posts.author: hmrhoward.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Schumer & Jeffries are not the answer!

representative_posts.author: msmosey.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Schumer and Jeffries MUST GO!! They will ruin our chances in the 2028 elections by continuing business as usual. Now they are trying to ride Progressive Democrats coattails into leadership when they DID NOTHING to help us.

representative_posts.author: shazzab.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I think Jeffries and Schumer are not the right people for this moment. I’m not feeling tolerant about infighting either. Bit of a dilemma. They need to get their shit organized short-, mid-, and long-term and demonstrate leadership that meets the people’s mandates. Our voices won’t be silenced.

representative_posts.author: pjdillon.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Democrats need to get their shit together. We don't want Schumer or Jeffries. Don't fuck this up. You Represent us and we collectively don't want either of them because of their absolute shit decisions they've made which is prelude to the shit decisions their going to make. Don't sell us out

representative_posts.author: deletex.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Schumer and Jeffries must go. Enough of this good old boy network in the pocket of corporate and foreign interests. Enough.

representative_posts.author: coronasun62.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Yes please!!! I am angry that Schumer and Jeffries are being considered to be the leaders and already talking compromise with Trump! Like WTF?!

representative_posts.author: sp4zsquatch.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Schumer is too compromised because of who his donors are. Jeffries too.

representative_posts.author: betsy-cazden.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Anyone who's coming in from outside and imagines that Schumer played no role in the Democratic victories needs to take a seat and wait until they learn how things really work in the Senate. Same for Jeffries and the House.

representative_posts.author: oreored.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Tom Nichols then you haven’t been a big enough critic of Schumers if you still support him. Hakeem Jeffries and Chuck Schumer are what is wrong with the Democrat party. New leadership.

representative_posts.author: projectspacetime.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Hear this guy out. He’s making it clear about what’s going to happen due to how Schumer and Jeffries have told all of us to shut the fuck up.

representative_posts.author: newsbynature.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: This is why we need new leadership. Does anyone really think Schumer and Jeffries are going to take the dirty money out of our electoral process when they depend on it so heavily.

representative_posts.author: titubasrevenge.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I agree. No to Jeffries. No to Schumer. We voted you new Dems in for change. We expect to see big changes starting with Democrat leadership.

representative_posts.author: dabenner.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Well the dilemma here is both Schumer and Jeffries have strong blind spots that lead them to take obnoxious positions, but "Not Schumer" is not the candidate. So it's just posts into the void.

representative_posts.author: southysouthpaw.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Neither Schumer nor Jeffries are the leaders needed for this new reality and new "America" we find ourselves in. We need strong transformative leaders, not status quo leaders.

representative_posts.author: mat111.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Accountability is IMPORTANT so we can show this will not be allowed to happen again. Jeffries needs to be replaced and Schumer needs to exit as well!

representative_posts.author: pk-solo-1.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: We can thank Schumer & Jeffries for their previous leadership gracefully and ask them to stand aside. They deserve respect for years of service. However, these are unprecedented times we’ve lived through & the newer, younger, female led future is here. They are energized to take this corruption on.!

representative_posts.author: bchristyb.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: 💯 Schumer needs to usher in a new generation of Dem leadership. The time is now! Jeffries befriended Kushner & welcomed war criminal Netanyahu to the House. And his comments after Tuesday’s political earthquake were so milquetoast, feckless & tone deaf. We need courageous, fierce leaders now!

representative_posts.author: riem.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Every Democrat I have seen on SM and elsewhere, wants Schumer and Jeffries gone, effective immediately. Certainly have only seen Schumer described as the architect of the Blue Wave here:

representative_posts.author: jaylk.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Willing to give Jeffries a shot but Schumer has to go. He flies in to raise money (pick a state), takes credit, and does absolutely nothing bold. His number 1 priority has always been preservation of his power. Seniority system is bullshit.

representative_posts.author: robotimpurity.com
representative_posts.text: I've already contact all three of my reps to let them know Schumer and Jeffries aren't meant this moment in history. I encourage every US voter to do the same.

representative_posts.author: lordboise.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: So far, absolutely no one wants that wretched job other than Schumer. He has maybe 6 Senators wanting to replace him. It'll take 2 things - 1. An opponent to run against him and 2. 28 votes for that opponent.

representative_posts.author: motherofcardigans.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Throwing this out there- Schumer has no business being Senate Majority Leader. We need new leadership for a new era.

representative_posts.author: beatlebomb.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Schumer is a dud and always has been. He's a capitulator. He needs to step aside. If he doesn't, we will kick him out.

representative_posts.author: researchette.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: And for some reason he feels strongly about Schumer and Jeffries staying in leadership.

representative_posts.author: marilynmaskell.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Agree 💯 Schumer is not the person to lead the change we voted for!

representative_posts.author: reagen.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: It seems extremely telling that people want Schumer gone (which I understand!) but everyone thinks someone else should be the leader.

representative_posts.author: saltybiscuit.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I’m just hoping this galvanizes Schumer, Jeffries, and old guard. Who all, by the way, need to be driven out of leadership in January and shown the door in their next election cycle. Not that I have much hope of that happening.

representative_posts.author: raybeckerman.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The problem with Schumer and Jeffries is that they think they know better than their constituents. They don't understand that they work for us, we don't work for them.

representative_posts.author: f150-93.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Written that way, Trump did Dems a favor. Now to jettison Schumer and Jeffries…

representative_posts.author: fascismheckler.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: So everyone saying "WE NEED TO OVERTHROW SCHUMER AND JEFFRIES", find a new hobby. Schumer said he already has the voters to be Majority Leader. And NOTHING is stopping Jeffries from becoming Speaker. Trying to argue against it proves how little you respect Black people

representative_posts.author: cosmonomadxazos.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Uhh... Saying Schumer and Jeffries "orchestrated" this win absolutely ignores that they also *refused* to support or endorse MANY Democratic candidates in the midterms. Candidates who just happened to be 1) Black and/or 2) openly opposed to g3nos!d3. Seeking new leadership seems 100% appropriate.

representative_posts.author: shaunvids.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: people who give schumer and jeffries credit for victories that they either had nothing to do with or actively worked to prevent really piss me off. any success their party is having is happening despite their efforts

representative_posts.author: alkramer.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: If Schumer had had his way, Mike Rogers would have defeated the moderates ( and AIPAC’s) preferred candidate, Haley Stevens! First order of business is to clear him out of the leadership!

representative_posts.author: joshuahind.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Giving Schumer credit for a landside which saw a host of candidates the Democratic establishment either neglected or actively worked against coming to Congress is...the fuckin' Atlantic for ya.

representative_posts.author: mayhem1994.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Reminder: Unfortunately for Chuck Schumer and Hakeem Jeffries more than a few of the candidates that WON on Tuesday did so IN SPITE of Schumer and Jeffries’s opposition to their candidacy in the primaries. Like my mayor. They have already signaled a lack of intention to give them a Vote

representative_posts.author: sethanikeem.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Way too many of these folks are on the same payroll - and they DO NOT serve the people Get Schumer OUT!

perspectives.title: Miller Appointment
perspectives.summary: Stephen Miller is a bad choice

representative_posts.author: comminicate26.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Raise hell about Millers appointment! Make certain trump understands he is complacent in all Millers crimes.

representative_posts.author: leyes3.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Stephen Miller is going to bring Trump the rest of the way down

representative_posts.author: poormonger.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Stephen Miller is the guy behind all of Trump’s worst policy ideas and actions. Elevating him in this moment should be a bright red flag that he’s really been steering things this whole term. They have just grown tired of keeping up any other pretense.

representative_posts.author: lujan.senate.gov
representative_posts.text: Stephen Miller is the architect of some of the worst and most dangerous of the Trump administration's policies. He should have been fired a long time ago. Now he’s going to have to go up against one of the strongest Democrat majorities in the Senate and House. You will be held accountable.

representative_posts.author: artemisprime.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Miller has his head so far up his own ass and Trump’s ass that he’s going to make some very bad, cruel calls…and it will never occur to him of the super bad optics, that the public will hate it, and it will only dig a deeper hole for Trump & the GOP. But he’ll cause plenty of damage as they go down

representative_posts.author: blackmammoth25.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Stephen Miller is now the Chief of Staff for the White House. Trump is trying to circle the wagons, he's going to do what he can to remove anyone who isn't completely loyal to him. Get ready to fight!

representative_posts.author: blueunikorn.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The only good thing about this is that Miller is out of the shadows and I hope has a target squarely on him for all the crimes against humanity he has helped orchestrate.

representative_posts.author: thisuserisdumb.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The Republican party is going to regret having Stephen Miller as Trump's Chief of Staff!

representative_posts.author: annmb48.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Thank you for including me in another great starter pack. 💙🩵💙 It’s worrying that Trump has brought Miller out of the shadows. As predicted, he’s learned nothing from the election results. Miller is hard line fascist. No empathy or humanity. He’ll try to double down.

representative_posts.author: judyhampden.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Stephen Miller is now in control of *everything*. Trump Elevates Stephen Miller, a Fiery Hard-Liner, to Chief of Staff FREE GIFT 🎁

representative_posts.author: kaysid.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: What to Know About Stephen Miller, Trump’s New Chief of Staff he’s a piece of shitt

representative_posts.author: sethabramson.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: 10/ I've studied Trump for a decade. It's been my job. And I'm telling you that this is a decision Trump.made out of rage, bitterness, and the sort of fear you see from cornered animals. I think he made this choice to cause America pain. And I think Miller is perfectly constructed to be that weapon.

representative_posts.author: sethabramson.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: 9/ I know some may be tempted to say, "Sure, but Trump won't put up with such an attention-grabbing maelstrom of nonsense for long." And there remains a slight chance that such folks are right. But here's the problem: Trump knew *exactly what Miller is* when he chose to put him in charge of America.

representative_posts.author: anima1.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Miller is Trump’s revenge on Latino voters. Plus he’s going to check out and let Miller be de facto president.

representative_posts.author: starchildofjupiter.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Yeah, these next weeks before the new Congressmembers are sworn in just might be the worst we have seen. Stephen Miller is a traitor to the American people, our government, AND our Constitution! He should be charged and convicted of treason!

representative_posts.author: steve-holcombe.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: That's what Trump and Miller want you to think. That Trump has chosen Miller as his Chief of Staff is the final straw for me. It's a two for one. Politically kill two birds with one impeachment stone. Do it.

representative_posts.author: lurkinmostly.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I saw Trump speak about Miller once, he was referring to how he wants Trump to deport everyone who doesn't look like him. I think the narcissist in chief appreciates having a someone who would be willing to do evil things for him due to aligned prejudice. Miller has courted him this way.

representative_posts.author: camillelaguire.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Oh, Trump WANTS Miller to stir up negative attention - he can enjoy it vicariously while Miller takes the heat. Meanwhile Trump won't hesitate to throw him under the bus if he ever feels he needs to. Miller is both a weapon and a shield.

representative_posts.author: hippiesaladchef.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: This isn’t because Trump chose Miller. This is Miller keeping a tighter leash on Trump.

representative_posts.author: trixxyil.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Let’s not give Miller too much credit. He’s hiding from prosecution and waiting to be the fall guy. Miller won’t be “doing” anything but making vile on camera statements. Spokesmodel for fascism.

representative_posts.author: stevenfleiner.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Appointing Miller means Trump is either the world’s biggest masochist or an Antifa mole positioned to destroy the Republican party.

representative_posts.author: chitek.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I don’t think my emotions and opinions have ever changed as quickly as when I read Miller was now Chief of Staff. Racist, fear mongering, nazi Voldemort is now in charge of who Dump meets with, the information (or lack thereof) surrounding him, and POLICIES of the USA. God help us all. #impeachNOW

representative_posts.author: pampalmeresq.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: INSTEAD OF READING THE ROOM, OR, IN THIS CASE, THE COUNTRY, HE DOES THE EXACT OPPOSITE. PROMOTING STEPHEN MILLER TO WHITE HOUSE CHIEF OF STAFF IS A DISASTROUS DECISION. YET, IT’S TYPICAL TRUMP, I.E., EXTREMELY POOR JUDGMENT. TRUE LEADERS WOULD NEVER DO THIS…

representative_posts.author: daviddillard.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Trump made Miller his new … minister of propaganda! Miller is good at amplifying and repeating Trumps lies as well as making up new lies!#Miller

representative_posts.author: thoseschmitt.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I believe DT’s appointment of Stephen Miller will just reinforce the revolt against his Admin! While one of the most dangerous steps DT has taken, longer term this will really work against him. It’s making it clear just how much he doesn’t give a sh#t about the American people or what they think.

representative_posts.author: portiamcgonagal.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Yes, Miller's a slimy shitweasel. But what I think this reflects is that Trump's given up and is bored. He'll spend the remainder of his term playing with his construction Legos. "President Miller" is really in charge, and that narrative gets under Trump's thin skin.

representative_posts.author: rodsdad.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Now that Trump has chosen Stephen Miller as his Chief of Staff, it appears he’s hardening his line. Miller is a White Nationalist and a Nazi. That means Democrats can’t play nice. We need younger, more aggressive leaders spearheading the fight to control the purse strings and make them accountable.

representative_posts.author: untimelygamer.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Miller won't succeed in changing the political tide, of course, but I doubt he thinks he will. He wants to send as many minorities to concentration camps as possible while he has power.

representative_posts.author: overdone.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Miller coming out of the gate saying "we have to fight now to protect the pos ( oops! My bad) pres". He acts like he's going to war, not changing an office.

representative_posts.author: michaelrabbitt.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: “Having a white nationalist running the White House is not a good sign. Miller’s elevation…is a bad signal for what Trump’s endgame will be as a lame-duck president…he’s been the central figure in Trump’s brazen abuse of executive power and his deadly deportation campaign.”

representative_posts.author: chainmailedheart.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Vought first. Miller is a psychopath, I'm hoping he'll dig his own political grave as chief of staff.

representative_posts.author: yollybsky.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: "Stephen Miller is a dangerous xenophobe and reckless extremist who has American blood on his hands," Democratic House leader Hakeem Jeffries wrote on X. "His presence in government should be eradicated like a malignant tumor."

representative_posts.author: excelafrica.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: “Stephen Miller belongs nowhere near the Oval Office,”the NAACP president said. “He belongs before a judge. He’s a thug who will be remembered as the architect of Trump’s vile and authoritarian regime.” #ICE

representative_posts.author: dee20002.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Yeah, that's bullshit. Miller has been Trump's head of the SS since the ban on muslims way back in Trump#1.

representative_posts.author: pauleric70.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Kyle Kulinski: “Stephen Miller is a Jewish Nazi. That’s what he is. He is Trump’s id. He is the worst instincts all wrapped up in one person. I shudder at the thought of what comes next. There’s no way this ends well. We’re in the Hitler in his bunker phase of Trumpism”

representative_posts.author: democrats-judiciary.house.gov
representative_posts.text: Hiring Stephen Miller as Chief of Staff guarantees more violent paramilitary tactics in American communities, more bloody forever wars, more trillions added to the national debt, more idiotic tariffs, more inflation and more corruption. 2/3

perspectives.brief: The game remake is well received. it's a perfectly paced game. it's a good-ass remake. it's still the best game ever made.
perspectives.detail:
Game Remake argues that the game remake is well received. it's a perfectly paced game. it's a good-ass remake. it's still the best game ever made.

The posts defend it in their own words. @ghostkumo.bsky.social writes, “Like many things, the issue feels more a matter of prevalence and abundance. Remakes aren't even new to that console by Nintendo, SM64 got a remake over 20 years ago. But the volume of them in an era of long dev cycles just feels extra cynical, a sign of lessening creativity.” @theswweet.myatproto.social writes, “This is very true, but also a big part of the problem these days is that games as software were inherently coded for a specific platform, and as such at a certain point it just does make more sense to do a full remake rather than porting or developing an emulator to make a game…” @menutowngames.com writes, “man what a good-ass remake, the combat is great... I just finished the second dungeon while taking breaks occasionally and working on my games... now I'm so excited for the adult sections.”

Christmas Timing argues that Christmas starts too early. Christmas feels less special when it starts too soon. Christmas should wait until its actual season. Starting Christmas in November is overwhelming.

The posts defend it in their own words. @badbisque.bsky.social writes, “imagining a guy jacking off to a Christmas Carol and laughing sooo hard lmao” @gjmaupin.bsky.social writes, “We're not a Nov 1 = Xmas house but there are certain transitional movies we use to stave off peer pressure: -The Nightmare Before Christmas (clearly a between-holiday movie); -Bell, Book & Candle (ditto—lack of Oxford is on them, btw); -Oliver!” @revdaniel.bsky.social writes, “That’s always the case. I mean, at the end of the day people are free to do what they want - but if you’re going to “celebrate a season” why not wait for the actual season? Christmas STARTS Dec 24 -it doesn’t end on Boxing Day. But that’s a battle we lost long ago.”

perspectives.brief: People wish each other a good morning.

Good morning argues that People wish each other a good morning.

The posts defend it in their own words. @zeuss69.bsky.social writes, “Good morninggg, or good evening, whatever time it is 🤣 We’re horny, so let’s go shopping 🍌👅 A few little surprises as always 💦” @bluestormcomin1.bsky.social writes, “Good morning happy Saturday #Caturday 👋 There were parties last night and will be more tonight so join us! If you are a follower of mine and want your account boosted only party tonight leave a comment or 👋 Have an awesome day everyone ❤️☮️ repost #Blues #BluesInAction #BSC1” @akiratrails.bsky.social writes, “Good morning & happy Schera Saturday! Hope everyone has a wonderful day~ Todays plans are just reading & watching YT. May play Modded Minecraft if im in the mood for it too. 📚🖥🎮 Stay safe & hydrated everyone!”

Inside Good morning, the posts are arguing one position rather than a stack of unrelated claims.
